name: crypto_price
description: Retrieves a real-time price quote for any cryptocurrency from the CoinGecko market data API. Accepts a coin name or common ticker symbol and returns the current fiat price, 24-hour percentage change, market capitalisation, and 24-hour trading volume in the requested currency. Supported symbols include BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, MATIC, LINK, AVAX, BNB, and 10,000+ additional CoinGecko-listed coins. Use this tool when an agent needs the current price of a digital asset, needs to value a cryptocurrency holding in fiat currency, check a coin's intraday performance, or report on live crypto market conditions. Do not use this tool for historical price data, order book data, or tokens not listed on CoinGecko.

coin.description: Cryptocurrency name or ticker symbol. Accepts common symbols (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, MATIC, LINK, AVAX) or full names (bitcoin, ethereum, solana). Case-insensitive.

currency.description: Target fiat currency code for the price. Defaults to USD. Examples: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, chf, aud, cad.

include_market_data.description: Whether to include market capitalisation and 24-hour trading volume alongside the price. Defaults to true.
